labels.rationale: Asks for new behaviour: Table title to accept types beyond str and Text.

body:
This is a feature request: it asks for `Table(title=...)` to accept more types than `str` and `Text`. Per the [feature request template](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md), new features are only considered once they are approved in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions), so please start the proposal there.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
